description: Registry of issue-type category labels and definitions for the taxonomy (t/4828). Slug is the canonical identifier; label is the display name. Consumed by UI (taxonomy-editor) and PowerShell (Invoke-IssueTypeClassification).

loss_of_control.label: Loss of Control
loss_of_control.definition: Concerns about inability to govern or predict AI system behavior as capabilities scale.

misuse.label: Misuse
misuse.definition: Risks from intentional harmful use of AI systems by human actors.

power_concentration.label: Power Concentration
power_concentration.definition: Consolidation of economic or political power through AI capabilities.

economic.label: Economic
economic.definition: Effects on labor markets, resource allocation, wealth distribution, or economic stability.

political.label: Political
political.definition: Impacts on governance, institutional capacity, democratic processes, or international relations.

social.label: Social
social.definition: Effects on human relationships, social cohesion, cultural norms, or quality of life.
